title: Local Density Approximation for the Canonical Functional
exact_target: Justify the local-density approximation for the fixed-particle-number density functional.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005744 (OWR-14298014-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Mathematics of Many-body Fermionic Systems (2023), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2023/49, pp. 2809--2849. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The canonical constraint is essential: a grand-canonical result does not automatically settle this question. Scaling, particle number and interaction are those of the report.
